events.title: Watch Duty deploys Gemini across wildfire radio monitoring
events.title_zh: Watch Duty 将 Gemini 用于野火无线电监听
events.summary: Google and Watch Duty described a deployed transcription pipeline for roughly 400 active VHF wildfire radio feeds and more than 200 audio hours per day. The partners report word error rate falling from 38% to 22.34% on degraded audio and volunteer satisfaction rising from 35.3% to 92.3%. Humans still verify critical alerts before publication.
events.summary_en: Google and Watch Duty described a deployed transcription pipeline for roughly 400 active VHF wildfire radio feeds and more than 200 audio hours per day. The partners report word error rate falling from 38% to 22.34% on degraded audio and volunteer satisfaction rising from 35.3% to 92.3%. Humans still verify critical alerts before publication.
events.summary_zh: Google 与 Watch Duty 公开了一条已部署的转录流水线，用于约 400 路活跃 VHF 野火无线电和每天 200 多小时音频。双方称嘈杂音频的词错误率从 38% 降至 22.34%，志愿者满意度从 35.3% 升至 92.3%。关键警报发布前仍由人核验。
events.why_it_matters: This is a concrete high-noise, high-stakes deployment rather than a generic speech benchmark. It supports using models for triage while keeping humans responsible for consequential alerts; results come from a Google partner case study and lack independent evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_en: This is a concrete high-noise, high-stakes deployment rather than a generic speech benchmark. It supports using models for triage while keeping humans responsible for consequential alerts; results come from a Google partner case study and lack independent evaluation.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 这不是普通语音 benchmark，而是高噪声、高风险的真实部署。它支持“模型先分流、人再确认”的做法；数字来自 Google 与合作方案例，尚无独立评测。

technical_details.incident_example: Railroad Fire dispatch flagged in under 30 seconds in July; humans verified before a critical alert
technical_details.human_role: Critical information is reviewed before publication

events.title: OpenAI reports stronger defenses against adversarial distillation
events.title_zh: OpenAI 公布对抗式蒸馏防护进展
events.summary: OpenAI described a layered defense against attempts to copy frontier-model capabilities through unauthorized distillation. It combines model training, classifiers, API protections and campaign investigation. In an internal adaptive evaluation, protected-reasoning extraction success fell from 54.0% on GPT-6 Astra with its original safeguards to 0.2% on GPT-6.2 Astra. The evaluation and campaign data are publisher-run and are not independently reproducible from the release.
events.summary_en: OpenAI described a layered defense against attempts to copy frontier-model capabilities through unauthorized distillation. It combines model training, classifiers, API protections and campaign investigation. In an internal adaptive evaluation, protected-reasoning extraction success fell from 54.0% on GPT-6 Astra with its original safeguards to 0.2% on GPT-6.2 Astra. The evaluation and campaign data are publisher-run and are not independently reproducible from the release.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 公布了一套针对未授权模型蒸馏的分层防护，结合模型训练、分类器、API 防护与协同行为调查。内部自适应评测中，受保护推理被提取的成功率从 GPT-6 Astra 原防护下的 54.0% 降至 GPT-6.2 Astra 的 0.2%。评测和行动数据均由发布方运行，无法依据本次材料独立复现。
events.why_it_matters: For API and model-security teams, rate limits alone are not a sufficient extraction boundary. Request-level controls, model-side resistance and cross-account campaign analysis need to reinforce one another, while the headline metric still needs independent scrutiny.
events.why_it_matters_en: For API and model-security teams, rate limits alone are not a sufficient extraction boundary. Request-level controls, model-side resistance and cross-account campaign analysis need to reinforce one another, while the headline metric still needs independent scrutiny.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 API 与模型安全团队来说，单靠限流不足以阻止能力提取。请求级控制、模型自身抗提取能力与跨账户调查需要互相补强；核心数字仍需独立审查。

technical_details.defense_layers: model training, classifiers, API protections and coordinated-campaign investigation
technical_details.publisher_reported_extraction_success: 54.0% on GPT-6 Astra with original safeguards; 0.2% on GPT-6.2 Astra

events.title: OpenAI releases MedChemBench for medicinal-chemistry reasoning
events.title_zh: OpenAI 发布药物化学推理评测 MedChemBench
events.summary: OpenAI introduced MedChemBench, a 99-problem benchmark built from 117 papers and patents and 761 molecular structures. It tests structure reconstruction, evidence-based reasoning, compound selection and property prediction. OpenAI reports GPT-6.2 Astra at 84.5% available credit at xhigh, but the benchmark and reported model results come from the publisher and do not show clinical or drug-discovery success.
events.summary_en: OpenAI introduced MedChemBench, a 99-problem benchmark built from 117 papers and patents and 761 molecular structures. It tests structure reconstruction, evidence-based reasoning, compound selection and property prediction. OpenAI reports GPT-6.2 Astra at 84.5% available credit at xhigh, but the benchmark and reported model results come from the publisher and do not show clinical or drug-discovery success.
events.summary_zh: OpenAI 发布 MedChemBench：99 道题来自 117 篇论文与专利，覆盖 761 个分子结构，测试结构重建、证据推理、化合物选择和性质预测。OpenAI 自报 GPT-6.2 Astra 在 xhigh 下获得 84.5% 可得分。评测与模型结果均由发布方提供，不能推导为临床或药物发现成功率。
events.why_it_matters: For scientific-agent evaluators, this offers a task set closer to medicinal-chemistry decisions than generic science QA. Teams should treat it as scoped evidence about representations and trade-off reasoning, not proof that a model can autonomously develop drugs.
events.why_it_matters_en: For scientific-agent evaluators, this offers a task set closer to medicinal-chemistry decisions than generic science QA. Teams should treat it as scoped evidence about representations and trade-off reasoning, not proof that a model can autonomously develop drugs.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对科学 agent 评测团队来说，它比通用科学问答更接近药物化学决策。它只能说明模型在结构表示和多目标权衡上的局部能力，不能证明模型能自主研发药物。

technical_details.evidence_limit: publisher-built benchmark and publisher-run results; not a clinical or end-to-end discovery measure
technical_details.time_basis: Official page gives November 20, 2026 without time; no hourly-boundary claim is made

events.title: Thinking Machines releases Inkling 2 Mini for local multimodal inference
events.title_zh: Thinking Machines 发布本地多模态模型 Inkling 2 Mini
events.summary: Thinking Machines Lab released Apache-2.0 weights for Inkling 2 Mini, a 26B-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts model with about 3B active parameters per token and a 1M-token context window. The roughly 20GB checkpoint targets Apple silicon with at least 32GB memory and single-GPU systems, with support across Transformers, SGLang, vLLM and local runtimes. Most quality claims remain publisher-run.
events.summary_en: Thinking Machines Lab released Apache-2.0 weights for Inkling 2 Mini, a 26B-parameter multimodal mixture-of-experts model with about 3B active parameters per token and a 1M-token context window. The roughly 20GB checkpoint targets Apple silicon with at least 32GB memory and single-GPU systems, with support across Transformers, SGLang, vLLM and local runtimes. Most quality claims remain publisher-run.
events.summary_zh: Thinking Machines Lab 以 Apache 2.0 发布 Inkling 2 Mini 权重。它是约 260 亿参数、每个 token 激活约 30 亿参数的多模态 MoE，支持 100 万 token 上下文。约 20GB 的 checkpoint 面向 32GB 以上 Apple silicon 与单 GPU，并覆盖 Transformers、SGLang、vLLM 和本地运行时。多数质量结论仍来自发布方。
events.why_it_matters: For local-model and RAG teams, a compact multimodal model with broad day-zero runtime support is immediately testable on developer hardware. The looped architecture saves stored weights but still executes repeated layer visits, so memory fit does not imply low latency.
events.why_it_matters_en: For local-model and RAG teams, a compact multimodal model with broad day-zero runtime support is immediately testable on developer hardware. The looped architecture saves stored weights but still executes repeated layer visits, so memory fit does not imply low latency.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对本地模型与 RAG 团队来说，这是一款可立即在开发者硬件上验证、运行时支持较完整的多模态模型。循环层减少的是存储权重，推理仍要重复执行多次；能放进内存不等于延迟低。

technical_details.architecture: 24 physical decoder layers; middle 12 repeat three times for 48 layer applications; 8 of 128 experts per token
technical_details.size: about 26B total, about 3B active per token; roughly 20GB mixed NVFP4/MXFP8 checkpoint
technical_details.context: 1M tokens; text and image input, text output
technical_details.availability: Apache 2.0 weights; Apple silicon 32GB+, DGX Spark and other 32GB+ accelerators; multiple serving frameworks
technical_details.evidence_limit: publisher benchmarks and informal tests dominate; independent latency and task-quality evidence is limited
technical_details.time_basis: Model card and Hugging Face article give November 20, 2026 without time; no hourly-boundary claim is made

technical_details_zh.架构: 24 个物理 decoder layer；中间 12 层重复三次，共执行 48 层；每个 token 从 128 个专家中激活 8 个
technical_details_zh.规模: 总参数约 260 亿，每 token 激活约 30 亿；混合 NVFP4/MXFP8 checkpoint 约 20GB
technical_details_zh.上下文: 100 万 token；输入文本和图像，输出文本
technical_details_zh.开放范围: Apache 2.0 权重；支持 32GB 以上 Apple silicon、DGX Spark 及其他 32GB 以上加速器；多种推理框架
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 以发布方 benchmark 和体验测试为主；独立延迟与任务质量证据有限

events.title: MiniMax releases code-backed automated cryptanalysis results
events.title_zh: MiniMax 发布带代码的自动密码分析结果
events.summary: MiniMax released papers and code for four cryptanalysis results that it says were primarily discovered by an internal model. The claims cover COLM forgery, TII McEliece challenge-key recovery, reduced-round ARADI attacks and SBC-VOLE secret-key recovery. Public artifacts make technical review possible, but the findings have not yet received independent cryptographic validation in this run.
events.summary_en: MiniMax released papers and code for four cryptanalysis results that it says were primarily discovered by an internal model. The claims cover COLM forgery, TII McEliece challenge-key recovery, reduced-round ARADI attacks and SBC-VOLE secret-key recovery. Public artifacts make technical review possible, but the findings have not yet received independent cryptographic validation in this run.
events.summary_zh: MiniMax 发布四项密码分析结果的论文和代码，并称这些结果主要由内部模型发现。目标包括 COLM 伪造、TII McEliece 挑战私钥恢复、ARADI 减轮攻击和 SBC-VOLE 私钥恢复。公开产物使技术复核成为可能，但本轮尚未核实到独立密码学验证。
events.why_it_matters: For AI-for-science and security teams, this moves beyond benchmark scores into inspectable research artifacts with potentially real protocol consequences. Claims about breaks and speedups require expert reproduction before any affected-system decision.
events.why_it_matters_en: For AI-for-science and security teams, this moves beyond benchmark scores into inspectable research artifacts with potentially real protocol consequences. Claims about breaks and speedups require expert reproduction before any affected-system decision.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 对 AI for Science 与安全团队来说，这不再只是 benchmark 分数，而是可能影响真实密码方案、且可检查的研究产物。任何受影响系统决策前，都必须由密码学专家独立复现攻击与复杂度。
